description:
## Goal

Static build-time / scan-time tool that walks a scenario UI's source AST, finds each `data-widget` boundary, and extracts text content underneath to build the embedding corpus for retrieval.

## Expected Work

- AST walker per the research algorithm.
- Collects JSX text children, hardcoded labels, form field names, section headings.
- Combines with declared description + tags to produce an embedding-ready document per widget.
- Outputs a structured index file that `agent-inbox-unified-retrieval` can consume.
- Handle widgets.ts parsing for declared metadata.

## Acceptance

- Given a scenario UI with declared + tagged widgets, the extractor produces one embedding doc per widget with the expected content.
- Missing `data-widget` usages and orphaned declarations are reported (for auditor rule reuse).
name: widget-static-extraction-indexer
title: Build the static AST-walking widget content extractor
